t.zh: 一段推理也能写成一句话：前提用「并且」连起来，作为「如果……那么……」的条件。
t.en: A piece of reasoning can be written as one sentence too: the premises joined by “and”, as the condition of an “if … then …”.

after.zh: 前提都真、结论为假的世界，叫<wiki-ref to="countermodel"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: A world where the premises hold and the conclusion fails is a <wiki-ref to="countermodel"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 用下面的元件，把这句话拼成公式。
brief.en: Build this sentence as a formula from the parts below.

say.zh: 要是人都会死，苏格拉底又会死，那苏格拉底就是人。
say.en: If every human is mortal and Socrates is mortal, then Socrates is human.

hint.zh: 最外面是「如果……那么……」；条件是两句用「并且」连起来，第一句是一整句 ∀。
hint.en: The outermost piece is “if … then …”; the condition is two sentences joined by “and”, the first a whole ∀ sentence.

say.zh: 要是人都会死，苏格拉底又会死，那苏格拉底就是人。
say.en: If every human is mortal and Socrates is mortal, then Socrates is human.

brief.zh: 这段推理写成了引理。造一个反例：前提都成立，结论不成立。
brief.en: The reasoning is written as a lemma. Build a counterexample: every premise holds and the goal fails.

hint.zh: 苏格拉底也可以是一条会死的狗。
hint.en: Socrates could be a mortal dog.

t.zh: 上方是这段推理写成的引理：横线上是前提，横线下是结论，它说前提都成立时，结论也成立。造一个前提都成立、结论不成立的世界，就说明它推错了。
t.en: Above is the reasoning written as a lemma: the premises over the line, the goal under it; it says the goal holds whenever the premises do. A world where the premises hold and the goal fails shows it is wrong.

t.zh: 名字也要在世界里指一样东西：选好「苏格拉底」是哪一样。
t.en: A name must stand for a thing in the world too: choose which thing is Socrates.
